primaryPolicy: original FireRed AND at least one coherent original physical channel when multichannel; unchanged primary PCM to Qwen
selection: relative-noise weighted temporal support; in-speech switching and invalid-source failover retained; no absolute RMS speech gate
channelPayload: independent continuous high-pass .97 per source, owned arrays, route identity distinct from selection identity
wiener: independent per-source calibration and continuous states; diagnostics only, no product callbacks

validation.hostSuite: passed; selector, calibration, bank states, decoder isolation, route history and capture ownership
validation.captureCompilation: passed against real Android API 35 signatures
validation.adapterCompilation: passed against Sherpa reference signatures with Android stubs

latestControlledSelectorReplay.hintScope: historical hints held constant to isolate selector change

limitations: fixed and replayed recordings do not establish device-wide or multilingual false-alarm rates
mono regression does not exhaust multichannel moving-source cases
shadow Wiener can admit noise and does not authorize alerts
